title: Slot Steal
description: A lifesteal-style mod using inventory slots instead of hearts. Kill players to gain slots, lose slots when dying!
body:
## Slot Steal
- A lifesteal-style inventory mod where your slots are your lives.
- Slot Steal ties your inventory space to your survival. Players start with limited slots, and every death costs another. Kill other players to steal their slots back. Lose all your slots? You're banned.
  
## Features
- 18 Starting Slots - Remaining 18 are locked with barriers
- Death Penalty - Each death locks one more slot
- PvP Rewards - Kill players to unlock slots and receive Slot Voids
- Auto-Ban - Lose all 36 slots and you're banned
- Revival System - Revive banned players using 9 Slot Voids

## Slot Void
- The Slot Void item unlocks one slot when used (right-click).
- Kill another player
- /withdrawslot command
- Recipe:
- ![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c71d58a7dbb3f117e624955025659ecc16529079.png)

## Commands
- /slots
- /withdrawslot [amount]
- /revive <player>

## Admin Commands
- /setslots
- /addslots
- /removeslots
- /giveslotvoid
- /resetslots
- /checkslots
- /adminrevive

## Optional
- [Slot Steal Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/slot-steal-resource-pack) - Custom Slot Void and Barrier textures
